normal: China / NL / US among top destinations
CBMM capacity overhang means soft steel demand / logistics more likely than 'mine empty'
yellow: MoM tonnes drop >~20–25% without a steel-demand story
Short strike / ANM inspect / Contagem–rail / Santos ferroalloy congestion
red: Sustained Araxá export collapse with fine steel demand
false_alarms: AIS Santos without FeNb ID (containers ≠ bulk ore AIS)
Battery-anode / Nb-oxide hype without plant impact

legend_detailed.Looks normal: Stable ~7–9 kt/mo Brazil FeNb, CBMM majority, familiar destinations, quiet locals; capacity overhang favors demand/logistics explanations over mine failure.
legend_detailed.Yellow flags: Sharp MoM volume drop without steel story; rising unit value with falling tonnes; short labor/ANM/rail/port events; CMOC or Niobec outages.
legend_detailed.Red flags: Multi-week CBMM halt; sustained Araxá collapse despite healthy steel demand; Brazil+Niobec together; export restriction/tax shock.
